title: Locked at the Entrance, Open Inside: Where RLVR Narrows the Solution Space
abstract: arXiv:2608.29188v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) substantially improves single-sample accuracy (pass@1) but causes the policy's solution space to contract, diminishing the returns of test-time scaling. In this work, we investigate where inside a reasoning trajectory this breadth is lost: does the policy fail to access a valid solution family, or does it fail to execute computation once initiated? To disentangle access from execution, we analyze the Countdown task, whose solution space can be exhaustively enumerated into discrete entrance families defined by the first operand and operator, across PPO on Qwen2.5-3B and GRPO on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. Across both training setups, solution coverage falls by up to 67%, halving even on problems solved across all checkpoints. translated_title: 入口紧锁，内部敞开：RLVR在何处收窄解空间
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）大幅提升了单样本准确率（pass@1），但会导致策略的解空间收缩，削弱测试时扩展的收益。在本工作中，我们研究了这种广度在推理轨迹内部的哪个环节丢失：是策略无法访问有效的解家族，还是在启动计算之后无法执行？为了将“访问”与“执行”区分开来，我们分析了Countdown任务，其解空间可以被穷举为由第一个操作数和运算符定义的离散入口家族，实验涵盖Qwen2.5-3B上的PPO和Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct上的GRPO。在两种训练设置中，解覆盖率下降高达67%，即使在所有检查点都能解决的问题上也减半。我们表明这种收缩高度集中在入口处：第一次算术运算之前的逐token似然偏移比计算过程中的偏移大11至16倍。
tldr: 本研究利用可穷举的Countdown任务发现，RLVR导致的解空间收缩主要集中在推理轨迹的“入口”处（首次算术运算之前），而非计算执行阶段，表明多样性损失源于策略无法访问有效的解家族。
en_tdlr: Using the exhaustively enumerable Countdown task, this work shows that RLVR-induced solution space contraction is concentrated at the "entrance" of reasoning trajectories (before the first arithmetic operation) rather than during computation, indicating diversity loss stems from the policy's failure to access valid solution families.
